images.name: Quiet Workshop
images.prompt: Create a high quality Minecraft Java vanilla-block interior design proposal, not a screenshot. One landscape image with a large perspective view into a square room showing two walls, floor and ceiling, plus two small clearly labeled square orthographic diagrams at right: FLOOR and CEILING. Room is 14x14 interior, 7 blocks high, 2x2 doorway. Whole opaque full cubes only, flush wall/floor/ceiling planes, recognizable vanilla pixel textures, no furniture, entities, glass, stairs, slabs or emitted lights. Rich deliberate material contrast and rhythm, interesting patterns, NOT blank concrete boxes. Essential: BOTH floor AND ceiling layout have EXACT fourfold 90-degree rotational symmetry: concentric frames, centered medallions, equal cross arms, or symmetrical grids. No one-direction-only beams or stripes. Right-hand diagrams must clearly show that symmetry. Plain even ambient light, no glow or fancy shader. Layout is a proposal; render as a polished Minecraft architectural study with readable block scale. Theme name as a small title. Theme: Quiet Workshop. Workshop of oak end-grain full logs, stripped spruce frame, polished andesite and stone brick panels, waxed copper accents. Floor concentric andesite/stone frames around four matching copper corner-insets; ceiling equal orthogonal stripped log coffer grid. Warm timber and cool stone balanced.
